description: This file contains a test class GetRelationshipCest for API testing within the SuiteCRM project. It tests retrieving relationships for the Account module via API endpoints, including both successful and error responses.

classes.name: GetRelationshipCest
classes.description: A test class for API relationship endpoint testing within SuiteCRM, focusing on the Account module's relationships.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Initial setup method that logs in before each test.

methods.name: shouldWork
methods.description: Tests that the relationship retrieval endpoint works correctly for a valid relationship, with handling for temporarily skipped loaded relationship cases.

methods.name: shouldNotWork
methods.description: Tests that requesting an invalid relationship returns a 400 error with proper message.

methods.name: shouldWorkDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data arrays for different API endpoints testing successful cases.
